name: epub-reader
tagline: Read EPUB books on your Even G2 glasses
description:
Read EPUB books directly on your Even Realities G2 smart glasses. Upload books from your phone or browse the Project Gutenberg Top 100 catalog, then read hands-free on the glasses.

Features:
- Local library: recent books cached on-device for offline reading
- Two reading modes: Paged (swipe to turn pages) and Flow (word-by-word speed reading, 120-600 WPM)
- Automatic hyphenation in 9 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian
- Splash screen with ePub Reader logo on startup
- Book picker on glasses: browse and resume books without the phone app
- Configurable status bar with reading progress
- Automatic position saving across app restarts
- Project Gutenberg integration

Controls:
- Swipe down/up: Next/previous page or browse chapters/books
- Tap: Select chapter/book or play/pause flow mode
- Double tap: Return to chapter list, book picker, or exit app
author: Andriy Chortkivskyy <evendev@proton.me>

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Internet access for downloading books from Project Gutenberg and Even Hub.
